source.section: PDF page 17, Schedule S Part A Line 1 (interest on obligations of states other than NC not included in federal AGI is added); Form D-400 Schedule S page 1 (PDF page 2), Line 1 and Line 16; D-401 PDF page 13, Line 7; PDF page 14, Lines 11, 14, 15

worked: Federal AGI = wages 50,750.00 (the 2,000.00 of other-state and 3,000.00 of NC municipal interest are tax-exempt and not in federal AGI). NC adds back only the other-state interest; no line adds the NC obligation interest, so it stays out. Federal taxable income = 50,750.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 35,000.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). D-400 Line 6 federal AGI 50,750.00. Line 7 additions (Schedule S Part A) 2,000.00 (Line 1 interest on other states' obligations 2,000.00). Line 8 = Line 6 + Line 7 = 52,750.00. Line 9 deductions (Schedule S Part B) 0.00. Line 10 child deduction 0.00 (no qualifying children). Line 11 NC standard deduction (single) 12,750.00. Line 12a = Lines 9 + 10 + 11 = 12,750.00; Line 12b = Line 8 - Line 12a = 40,000.00. Line 14 NC taxable income (full-year resident) = 40,000.00. Line 15 tax = 40,000.00 x 0.0425 = 1,700.00. Line 16 credits 0.00; Line 17 income tax = 1,700.00.
